remarks: Possibilities! This property is currently used as a religious facility but has many possibilities, including a residential home. If you are looking for space to accommodate your family and maybe extended family this could work for you. Another possibility would be having a home office and still have plenty of room for living space. Multiple rooms have potential for spacious bedrooms. Large kitchen could be just kitchen, or kitchen/dining area. If you like to entertain or maybe have a side business for catering etc. there are currently two full stoves and one additional oven. Large room off the kitchen would be a great Living room, and could be divided into smaller work area, or a home office with separate entry. Beautiful view from the covered porch looking over the valley. Detached one car garage currently used for storage. Additional 1.4-acre lot available for $20,000. Currently the property is tax exempt for religious use; but Town and county will be based on 26.957158 fire dept .335475 per 1,000 of assessed value; School and Library tax 27.683324 per 1,000 of assessed value
